evidence: EIA Form 860M May 2026 (Plant ID 64999) explicitly reports status '(L) Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction' as of May 2026

21-month Sentinel-2 timelapse (Jul 2024–Jun 2026, 21 monthly frames) shows undisturbed rural Leon County landscape at EIA-reported coordinates — no graded polygons, no racking, no substation pad visible in any frame
Full-size frame review: Jul 2024, Oct 2025, Jul 2026 all confirm stable farm/forest pattern with no utility-scale construction signal
Web search returns no EPC announcement, groundbreaking notice, or construction mobilization news from any admissible source

reasoning_evidence: No construction started as of Jun/Jul 2026: EIA 860M status '(L) not under construction' + satellite imagery both confirm; with reported COD May 2027 (~10 months away), a 324 MW build (typ. 18-24 months) cannot complete on schedule
8 COD changes over 6 years (2021-07-01 → 2027-05-01), total slip 6 years — highest structural drift signal in the dataset
Capacity bounced repeatedly (500→400→365→451→324 MW), suggesting ongoing scope/financing uncertainty

Positive: all ERCOT gates cleared (6.9 milestones met 2026-05-19, FIS approved 2026-03-13, IA signed 2021); Repsol is an active operator (Frye Solar 500 MW, Outpost 515 MW, Longhorn 650 MW all operating per EIA 860M)
Independent estimate 2028-Q1 assumes NTP/construction mobilization Q3 2026 → 18-month build → COD ~Q1 2028; slips to 2028-Q3 if start delayed to Q1 2027
